title: Glycine Helped Me Sleep Better Than Any Other Supplement
hook: I used to wake up sweating even with the AC at 67. Glycine helped me sleep better than any other supplement I've tried.
body:
I mixed 3 grams of glycine into water about an hour before bed. I stopped waking up hot, and my usual Oura sleep score moved up about five points. The ring also picked up a change in my overnight finger temperature.

I walk through what happened in my own bedroom, what the small, industry-funded sleep studies found, and why I still pay more attention to my bedtime and how much I drink.
close: What temperature do you keep your bedroom at?
